newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait refinery producing 125,000 bpd after glitch.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait refinery producing 125,000 bpd after glitch.

text.p: Kuwait's Shuaiba refinery has restored about 125,000 barrels per day (bpd) of its 200,000 capacity after a Tuesday power failure, an industry source said on Wednesday.

"The refinery is producing about 125,000 bpd after the restoration of the crude oil unit," a source close to Shuaiba operations told Reuters. "By tomorrow (Thursday) Shuaiba would have restored its full capacity."

State oil refiner Kuwait National Petroleum CO (KNPC), which runs Shuaiba along with two other domestic refineries, has said all operations at Shuaiba suffered a short stoppage on Tuesday due to power failure.
Kuwait has a domestic refining capacity of 895,000 bpd and a crude oil production of about two million bpd.
KNPC said the failure took place when technicians were running a routine check on electrical equipment at Shuaiba.
The reasons that led to the stoppage are being investigated, KNPC added.
